title: Prove four-channel factorization implies the C5 pivot equation
head: 07c57449e0d0fdd442bfdae31e087afe14b38c9a
body:
PR2525 explicitly assumed the normalized four-pivot equation. Prove the missing implication from an arbitrary factorization through four scalar channels, then apply its unchanged C5 obstruction. The new proof works over any nontrivial commutative ring and permits arbitrary nonsymmetric, noncommuting2x2 blocks.

Four-by-four determinant and adjugate identities establish reverse inversion of the selected factor pivot, and a sandwich identity derives the normalized equation. An explicit four-channel integer factorization of the one-edge-relaxed mask supplies a positive boundary control.

This closes factorization-to-pivot, not the ordinary field-rank-to-factorization library interface or the formal source JSON/C5/I44 embedding. The rank49 result remains credited to thakrarsagar/PR2484; the all-block-size written bound is already PR2541. No new optimum, native copy bill, supplier or exponent is claimed.
